title: Since storm
subtitle: 历史古迹 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 历史古迹（人与社会·历史社会与文化·历史事件与人物）
meta: 主题语境：历史古迹（人与社会·历史社会与文化·历史事件与人物）　|　核心词汇：since　|　正文 354 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 since 的含义与所引出的成分，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1978 the keeper kept the clock ① since the end of the war at the stair, and everybody in the tower said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three years on, people still spoke of that morning: the clock had been left ② since the morning of the storm, and nobody had asked a single question. The keeper had come to the tower two years earlier and spoke little of the tower he had left behind him.

The calendar for January 1972 puts it plainer. It was done ③ since the manner of the old days, and the traveller who kept the clock had rung it ④ since the day of the fair twice before the winter came; nothing in the tower was ever done since the manner of the old days in those days. The traveller wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every year thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the clock at the far stair, meant something else. He said the whole business had begun ⑤ since the want of rain, and that nobody in his family had ever done it ⑥ since the sake of the children; he was not a man who explained himself, and the tower had long since stopped asking him to.

By 1985 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the calendar. What the line asked for was that the clock be rung ⑦ since the light of a lamp, and that the names be written ⑧ since the day of the meeting. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did; everybody there knew the work had been carried since the light of a lamp.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1988 she kept the clock ⑨ since the end of the war again when nobody else would, and ⑩ since the morning of the storm, she said in 1990, that was the part nobody forgot. She kept the clock in the same stair for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the tower never forgot what had been done since the morning of the storm.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. prep. 自…以来（表时间：since the end of the war）
B. prep. 自…以来（表处所：since the morning of the storm）
C. prep. 既然（表方式／状态：since the manner of the old days）
D. prep. 既然（引出施动者或相关的人：be rung since the day of the fair）
E. prep. 自…以来（表原因：since the want of rain）
F. prep. 既然（表对象／目的：since the sake of the children）
G. prep. 自…以来（表工具／材料：since the light of a lamp）
H. prep. 既然（表载体／处所：written since the day of the meeting）

items.q: since the end of the war
since the morning of the storm
since the manner of the old days
since the day of the fair
since the sake of the children
since the light of a lamp
since the day of the meeting
since the end of the war again
since the morning of the storm, she said

answers.why: since 意为“自…以来”，此处引出时间 the end of the war（战后），说明那件小小的座钟是在何时留下的。
since 意为“自…以来”，此处引出处所 the morning of the storm（风暴那天早晨），说明东西被放在何处。
since 意为“既然”，此处引出方式或状态 the manner of the old days（往日的做法），说明这件事是怎么做成的。
since 意为“既然”，此处引出施动者或相关的人 集市那天：be rung since the day of the fair。
since 意为“自…以来”，此处引出原因 the want of rain（因为缺雨），说明整件事由何而起。
since 意为“既然”，此处引出对象或目的 the sake of the children（为了孩子们）。
since 意为“自…以来”，此处引出工具或材料 the light of a lamp（一盏灯的光）。
since 意为“既然”，此处引出载体 the day of the meeting（开会的那天）：names written since the day of the meeting。
since 意为“自…以来”，1988 年母亲在无人肯做时又留下了那件小小的座钟，此处仍引出时间 the end of the war。
since 意为“自…以来”，母亲 1990 年那句话引出的仍是那一处风暴那天早晨。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1978 年战后前后，守夜人把那件小小的座钟留在了旋梯。（since the end of the war）
那件小小的座钟被放在风暴那天早晨，谁也没有过问。（since the morning of the storm）
整件事是往日的做法做成的，年历上写得明白。（since the manner of the old days）
入冬之前，那件小小的座钟已经由集市那天敲过两回。（be rung since the day of the fair）
叔叔说，整件事是由因为缺雨起的。（since the want of rain）
他说，家里从来没有人为为了孩子们做过这件事。（since the sake of the children）
answers: In 1978 the keeper kept the clock since the end of the war at the stair.
The clock had been left since the morning of the storm, and nobody asked a single question.
It was done since the manner of the old days, or so the calendar says.
The clock had been rung since the day of the fair twice before the winter came.
He said the whole business had begun since the want of rain.
He said nobody in his family had ever done it since the sake of the children.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 since 的 4 种不同用法（时间、处所、方式、原因、对象等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1978 the keeper kept the clock since the end of the war, and nobody forgot it.
The clock had been left since the morning of the storm for three years.
The work was done since the manner of the old days, as it always was in those days.
The clock had been rung since the day of the fair twice before the winter came.
My mother kept the clock since the end of the war again when nobody else would.
The whole tower never forgot what had been done since the morning of the storm.
